tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. A cool graph-paper white in light, a blue-black lab bench in dark.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the reading-of-the-week panel, form fields.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Graph-paper lines and hairline dividers. Decorative only; never carries text or meaning.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, on paper, paper-raised, pen-soft and highlight.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, labels; on paper, paper-raised and pen-soft.

tokens.name: pen
tokens.usage: Ballpoint blue. Links, primary buttons, focus ring, the one action per view. As text, on paper, paper-raised or pen-soft.

tokens.name: pen-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted panels behind pen or ink text: the next-session card, selected states.

tokens.name: on-pen
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a pen fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Highlighter yellow. A marker swipe behind one key phrase per view. Text on it is always on-highlight.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on a highlight swipe, both themes (stays dark ink, like real highlighter).

tokens.name: solved
tokens.usage: Ticks and 'solved' states only: past sessions, problems marked solved, success messages. As text, on paper or paper-raised.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque. Headlines are questions or plain claims, sentence case.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The website hero only. One per page.

groups.name: Reading
groups.note: Source Serif 4. Everything people read at length.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: In October 1977, a hospital cook in Merca, Somalia became the last person to catch smallpox naturally.
styles.usage: Running text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Card text, FAQ answers, form help.

groups.name: Lab labels
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono. Short labels and data, set uppercase.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, session numbers, reading time, dates. Uppercase.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Figures in a sentence or a stat line.

groups.name: Margin notes
groups.note: Caveat. Used like a pen note in the margin: at most one per section.

styles.name: annotation
styles.usage: A single handwritten aside pointing at the thing that matters. Never body text, never buttons.

spacing.note: 4px base; layouts snap to the 24px graph-paper cell.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tags and small controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; gap between related items.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: One graph cell. Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Two cells. Between page sections.

tokens.name: grid-cell
tokens.usage: Pitch of the graph-paper background and the plus-grid pattern.

radius.note: Mostly square, like a notebook page. Small rounding on things you press.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, labels, the highlight swipe.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and avatar circles only.
